name: Forethought AI
tagline: Forethought is a generative AI platform for customer support that automates ticket triage, provides AI-powered response suggestions, and resolves common queries end-to-end. Its SupportGPT model is trained on support conversations, making it more accurate for customer service than general-purpose LLMs.
